methods_quotes.q: Standard summary measures (e.g., mean, median, and range) of the levels and changes in Hispanic teen birthrates were used
The mean percentage changes are averages of each county's percentage change in its Hispanic teen birthrate
This analysis is limited further to counties with > 20 Hispanic teen births in 1999 (n = 284) to increase statistical reliability.
